crossRefs.note: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me…
Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not…
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a…
Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king, instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon…
Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have…
For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…

translations.web: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
translations.bsb: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
translations.kjv: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.
